modern_index_text: law_names then article_numbers then original chunk text, newline separated
modern_query_tokens: same analyzer, unique nonempty alphanumeric-containing tokens, no expansion
dictionary: unmodified jieba 0.42.1 default dictionary and HMM resources; hashes recorded
strata: existing case_type plus explicit title-and-article shape vs scenario; no production parser gold
selection: Among the two modern arms with zero execution errors and deterministic repeats, choose maximum development Hit@5, then MRR, then lower warm p95 latency. This is an engineering/development choice, not independent legal-quality acceptance.
causal_limit: Historical vs modern changes engine, analyzer, index text and manual boosts together; it is a system comparison, not an isolated BM25-formula effect. A synthetic identical-token engine contract test isolates the formula separately.
runtime_scope: direct lexical ranking only; no chat refusal, exact routing, generation, embedding, reranker or checker
limits: 120 reused development cases; 108 retrieval-gold cases, 12 no-gold cases excluded from ranking denominators
No claim about Lucene/IK effectiveness without running them
No tuning dictionaries, parameters, gold or protocol after observing this run
